notes.title: One-Year Banaversary Event!
notes.content:
Hey there Banas!! Can you believe it's almost been an entire year since Bana Simulator released on the Steam Store? It's been an incredible experience to watch as all of you experience the game, and seeing our little, tight-knit community of Banas grow.


To celebrate this incredible milestone, we will be releasing our biggest update since launch, with hundreds of features including:
[list]
[*] A rework of Chapter One's story and enemies
[*] A dozen new Chapter 2 enemies
[*] A total rework of items and currency
[*] Several new optional questlines
[*] A rhythm game???
[*] Countless QOL features
[*] [b]Three new bosses[/b]
[/list]

In addition to this massive update, we will be holding a community event on [b]July 14th[/b] where we discuss the new features, talk about what's next, play the game, and have fun with you guys, so be sure to join us on our official [url=https://discord.gg/qUzBDU6zZP ]Discord server[/url] or [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCywvhxkXLusqB7k7ibqmfPg]YouTube channel[/url].

See you on our One-Year Banaversary!

Sorry about the radio silence for a while, we were on a short break from development, plus the time we did spend working was quiet because we're cooking up quite the update...

Steam cloud has now been added for Windows, with Mac support (and cross platform saves hopefully) being soon to follow. You can now enjoy one epic story across a laptop, pc, steam deck, and whatever steam-capable devices you have that we can't think of.

notes.title: Price Increase
notes.content:
I know it's bit late, but Happy Holidays, everyone! 

On [u]January 5th, 2024[/u], we will be increasing Bana Simulator's price from [b]5.99 USD[/b] to [b]16.99 USD[/b]. We have chosen to do this because we believe Bana Simulator is worth far more than its currently miniscule price tag, especially considering what we've been working on behind the scenes. This is NOT retroactive, so [b]any current owners of the game will see no changes. 
[/b]Considering the already considerable scale of Bana Simulator's campaign and the many, many planned story & content updates to come, we feel this is a more than justified change.

Do note that this is also NOT our full launch. As previously stated, we have plenty of work to do on this game.

And we encourage you to buy Bana Simulator now if you haven't already! We're on sale for the Steam Winter Sale anyway, so why not pick up a copy or two before the price increase? There's no reason not to!

Lastly, we want to thank you for being such a great community! You've been a tremendous help in the development of this game thus far, and we can't wait for you to see our work-in-progress content. Seriously, I cannot wait to show this stuff off. (Maybe I'll even sneak a couple teasers in this post!)

Well, I think this is probably going to be the last news of 2023, sorry it's not more exciting! This year we had our official launch, one major update, too many minor updates to count, and a limited time event. Happy Holidays, and see you next year!

notes.title: What Lies Below
notes.content:
[b]Discord Changelog[/b]

Just a heads up, you can't find the *full* changelog here, that will be on our [url=https://discord.gg/qUzBDU6zZP]discord server[/url] or on our [url=https://banasimulator.com/]website[/url].

[b]New Region[/b]

Beneath the Star Shaman's temple, under the soft soil of the marsh, is a remnant of a civilization long deceased. Be careful not to lose your way in these winding catacombs, and see if you can find an escape, before something else finds you...

The Crypts, although there are no "standard" levels within, has tons of content and lots of secrets for you to find while exploring. Unlike other regions, where you are perfectly safe outside levels, the monsters in the Crypts will always be hunting you, creating a feeling of suspense like no other areas in Bana Simulator. Be careful not to make a sound, you don't want to know what happens to Banas when these ancient aberrations catch one...

[b]Bow Rework[/b]

All bow type weapons have been given an incredible rework.
Now you can use the numerous items you collect across your journey to fletch your own arrows with special powers! Press "r" in combat to open the fletching menu, where you can craft arrows ranging from reinforced sticks to celestial arrows of mass destruction.

[b]Rain[/b]

I really hope you all know what rain is.

notes.title: Bana Beam Rework
notes.content:
[h1]Weapon Reworks[/h1]

The three "beam" class weapons all were extremely problematic, and although this game is only a number of weeks out from release this update is somehow long overdue.

[h2]Bana Beam[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42657326/9404b1da11c4699824b2d3a1ef8dc259593b62ec.png[/img]
The Bana Beam has been reworked so you now have to aim the laser with your mouse (No free aimbot?! Scandalous!) The damage has been reduced by 40%, although this sounds harsh, this isn't just a nerf! After testing we've found that the weapon (although unarguably weaker) is so much more fun to play with! Sure, you might not shred bosses to pieces as easily, but you get to have a better time while doing it!

[h2]Sunpower[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42657326/27ba5df5e062c6d40c1b5f2a0bf3d5dec6235254.png[/img]
The Sunpower is currently the most powerful and least used weapon in all of Bana Simulator, but we're hoping to change that!! The Sunpower now shoots several enemies in a cone pointed towards the player's mouse at damage comparable to late game weapons. In the next update, we will be working to make sure players can find the side quest to obtain this weapon, as very few of you Banas have found out how.

[h2]Fissure[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42657326/0b01f1977ead35d37324ee61a5a6e9e56bb150ca.png[/img]
The Fissure has always been a cumbersome weapon, it's damage is mostly dealt via fire which many enemies are immune/resistant to, and the fissures would erupt [i]near [/i]enemies but not on top of them, causing the fire to be [i]even more[/i] inconsistent. The weapon now deals a solid 4 damage to all enemies, and an extra 4 to those vulnerable to fire. Fissures will also erupt directly beneath enemies instead of in their predicted location when the Fissure is at it's peak.

[h1]Other Changes[/h1]

This update is focused on the Beams, but we of course have a plethora of other changes thrown in with these reworks.

[h3]Damage Adjustments[/h3]

All enemies have had their health multiplied by 10, and all weapons have had significant buffs to follow. We did this for two reasons, the first being so that weapons dealing fractions of damages could have their indicators read with greater efficiency and accuracy, and the second being that we wanted every hit to feel like it made a huge impact, for example if you hit an enemy square in the face with a giant battleax, it should say 50 damage, not 5. 
Note: there aren't battleaxes in the game yet, but who can say what's coming in the future ;)

[h3]Enemy Collisions[/h3]

Enemies now will pass through one another rather than collide. This may seem strange, but when playing the game, it is much easier to follow and feels more natural. This feature is one that we had been trying to implement since the beginning of development, so it's nice to see it finally make its way into the game.

[h3]Dialogue Adjustments[/h3]

Nothing huge, but we removed any dialogue that was both unfunny and unhelpful. There was simply no reason for it to be in the game other than padding play time, but we know you're here to play a video game, not read a book!

[h3]Performance Optimizations[/h3]

The explorable world remains very harsh on some CPUs, but we're doing our best to optimize it, one step at a time.

[h1]Full Changelog[/h1]

[list]
[*] Multiplied all damage and health values by 10
[*] Enemies will no longer collide with one another
[*] Completely overhauled Bana Beam
[*] Completely overhauled Sunpower
[*] Completely overhauled Fissure
[*] Syringe animation cancelling will no longer do damage
[*] The Star Ball will no longer remain on screen completely static if you leave the level during its spawn animation.
[*] You can no longer use weapons on the world map
[*] Minor optimizations
[/list]

notes.title: Final Preparations Update
notes.content:
Hey there Banas! We're making one update to get ready for the HUGE amount of content coming up soon, no spoilers today ;)

There's quite a bit to unpack so let's just get right down to the list of major features:

[h1]Opening Cutscene[/h1]

You'll have to see for yourself, but upon starting a fresh save file, Apple will give you a friendly introduction and tell you the story of how the evil Shadow Bana came to power in the first place. This is part of our attempt to orient Bana Simulator more towards it's rich storyline and share some of the deep lore beneath the Game's surface.

[h1]General Features[/h1]

[list]
[*] Complete overhaul of the Bana Rang
[*] Graphical overhaul of the Bana Blade
[*] Partial gameplay overhaul of the Bana Bow
[*] Added Poison damage
[*] Added Fire Damage
[*] Remade low-health indicators
[*] Significantly nerfed potassium buffer
[*] Rewrote some tutorial levels
[*] Idiot-proofed minigames
[*] Added (Are you ready for this) FLOORS!!
[/list]

[h1]New Weapons[/h1]

These weapons will be fully implemented in the very-near future with the next chapters of the Bana's story. For now you can only access them in endless mode.

[h3]Sunpower[/h3]

A medium-damage beam weapon that can hit many targets or plant a weaker flower as a sentry turret.

[h3]Haunted Hammer[/h3]

A high-damage melee weapon that can deal very high damage and gains power as it absorbs enemy's souls. Has a secondary drop-swing attack. This will eventually be a reward for a Halloween themed "Pumpkin Gourdian" boss.

[h3]Toxic Tentacle[/h3]

A new flail-type weapon that deals heavy poison damage.

[h3]Petal-rang[/h3]

A type of aquatic flower found in high cliffs that has sharp petals, usable as a high-power weapon.

[h3]Bramble Bow[/h3]

Launch brambles that trail your arrow or plant giant poisonous bushes.

[h3]Slingshot[/h3]

I really hope you know what one of these is...

[h3]Peblet Golems[/h3]

Little golems that you can throw at your enemies. Extremely cute, but even more deadly.

[h1]Setting the Stage[/h1]

It's no secret that we have a big update coming soon, as much as we'd like to share every detail of it now, some of the features aren't ready. There are dozens of hidden enemies, weapons, and levels included in the files of this update that won't be visible in any way just yet, but be patient. The wait won't be long...

All I will share is that the next update will include multiplayer networking, so get the word about Bana Simulator to your friends.

[h1]Play it Today - Beta Testers wanted!![/h1]

We will be giving out many more beta copies in preparation for the final stretch of Closed Beta development, so please get the word out to your friends, and join our [url=https://discord.gg/qUzBDU6zZP]Discord Server[/url] for more information on how you or your friends can play Bana Simulator for free as soon as possible.

notes.title: The Heavy Metal Update
notes.content:
[h1]New Levels[/h1]

Bana Simulator has gained 5 new levels, each introducing new mechanics and incredible challenges, mechanics, and enemies. No full island was added in this update, but a small side-island off the coast of Isla Bana.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42657326/b903dd4f316b3de40ed1b8dd3dbe2ea0a719b1de.png[/img]

[h2]Ballista Minigame[/h2]

The third of the new levels will have something very obvious to the player, a giant rolling ballista. The Spear Island off the coast of Isla Bana happened to have this lost weapon the Alchemist was working on. Shoot the targets and tread carefully because the enemies here are lethal.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42657326/3673db70850cb055e5edce7627f448753e582eae.png[/img]

[h2]New Enemies[/h2]

A large number of new enemies (mostly spear themed) are added with the Heavy Metal Update. 
[list]
[*] Exploding Spears,
[*] Spear Dashers,
[*] Coconuts,
[*] Sporb,
[*] Sporborb,
[*] Explorb
[/list]
just for a little taste.

[h3]Palm Trees[/h3]

The aforementioned coconuts do not spawn ordinarily but are summoned by Palm Trees. Every minute palm trees spawn a cluster of 3-5 coconuts. Although they are not significantly stronger than normal enemies, the coconuts can deal incredible damage in clusters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42657326/d761e0131301f4c14a72ab60d4a493a802e601fe.png[/img]

[h1]Armor[/h1]

Enemies can now become much fiercer by donning armor.
[olist]
[*] Plank Armor
[list]
[*] +1 Defense
[/list]
[*] Stone/Brick Armor
[list]
[*] +2 Defense
[*] +1 Attack
[/list]
[*] Copper Armor
[list]
[*] +3 Defense
[*] +1 Attack
[/list]
[*] Cobalt Armor
[list]
[*] +4 Defense
[*] +2 Attack
[/list]
[*] Gold Armor
[list]
[*] +5 Defense
[*] +2 Attack
[*] +2 Health
[/list]
[*] Shadow Armor
[list]
[*] +7 Defense
[*] +4 Attack
[*] +4 Health
[/list]
[/olist]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42657326/4cbd9e2dc27f4bad3bb6def772709276c0384a3a.png[/img]

[h1]Visual Improvements[/h1]

[h3]Damage Indicators[/h3]
From RPGs like [i]Final Fantasy[/i] to sandboxes like [i]Terraria[/i], almost every game out there has damage indicators to give players a sense of just how powerful their weapons are, and some players have had a tough time choosing weapons, so we added damage indicators to Bana Simulator!

[h3]New Lighting Effects[/h3]
New VFX have been added to enemy lasers, sunlight, weapons, and more! These effects have made the Bana Beam's special attack so much more satisfying to use...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42657326/9ab30f1088d183b8b1e2fad0da2b49a5093cbe1d.png[/img]

[h1]Supreme Spear Bossfight[/h1]

Some of you may remember this guy from the [i]really[/i] early days of Bana Simulator and will be happy to find out it has returned along with a *much* better weapon reward. No spoilers, but there's quite a few attacks here.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42657326/27a225a67174f6a832c19e0f142b4136350c995c.png[/img]

[h2]Competition Results[/h2]

The Space Race Competition is now complete, and the winner is... Wow this is quite a username, Urmomissus, who submitted their entry on the first day of the competition. We should be getting their customized weapon in the next patch. 

[h1]QOL Changes[/h1]

Changed current save slots to "Rollback Slots" and added a system of 3 save files. With this we also introduced backup save files, to prevent the tragic loss of a Bana that many players have experienced.

[h3]Hardcore[/h3]
The classic Permadeath game mode has found its way into Bana Simulator. Dying during the campaign will erase the players save file, excluding Endless Mode games on record, obtained skins, and Banacoin. Dying during endless mode will have no effect, despite being permadeath mode.

[h3]New Title Screen[/h3]
The title screen has been redesigned for a dark theme and the [i]Simulator[/i] text now gives the "neon" effect shown in the trailer. New animations for navigating in menus and the title screen have been added for a smoother experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42657326/760c32c8c47c27963eeff03f8ebce596df483abb.png[/img]

[h3]Reworked Loading Screen[/h3]
The old grey screen with a loading bar was always temporary (and excruciatingly boring), so we made a permanent loading screen with an animation and a fun background. To make the animation less laggy, saving has been threaded (fancy computer science words) so it runs very smoothly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42657326/b5045c1471824450c9e1d54888ba108230aab9a7.png[/img]

notes.title: The First Bana Competition!
notes.content:
Hello and welcome Banas, we have a very exciting announcement for you!


Today begins our first Bana Competiton, with incredible prizes, an awesome challenge, and at the end of the event, the introduction of several new skins!!! Before we get into that though, you're probably wondering what the event actually is.

[h1]Space Race Competition[/h1]

[b]NOTICE: This event is only available to our closed beta testers so we can see how Bana Competitions might work with a full player base in the future, you can request to become a beta tester at our [url=https://discord.gg/qUzBDU6zZP]Official Discord Server[/url].[/b]

To participate in the main competition, you'll have to play endless mode and get to [b]level 20[/b]. From there you will find the 5th and final, undiscovered [b]secret weapon...[/b] The challenge must be completed using this space themed weapon! Your goal is to get the most epic screenshot using this weapon, then submit it to our [url=https://discord.gg/qUzBDU6zZP]Discord Server[/url]! After submissions close, the judges will choose the best of the best, and players will vote for the winner!

If you are unsure how to submit a screenshot follow these steps.
[olist]
[*] Press f12 in game to take a screenshot,
[*] Go to Steam, click on Bana Simulator and scroll down until you see Screenshots on the right,
[*] Click "Manage my x screenshots",
[*] Press "Show On Disk" in the bottom left corner,
[*] Open Discord,
[*] Drag the screenshot from files into the submissions channel on the Discord server.
[/olist]

[h2]Competition Prizes[/h2]

[list]
[*] First Place will get to design their very own [b]Unique Weapon[/b] that will be added to the game!
[*] Second and Third Place will get a chance to design their own [b]Custom Skin[/b] that will be included in the next major update.
[*] Fourth and Fifth Place will get the entire register of [b]Space Skins[/b] as they release in the next update
[*] All other participants will get one new skin with the release of the next update.
[/list]



[h1]Art Contest[/h1]

Alongside the Space Race competition, Bana Simulator will have a [b]Fanart Contest[/b]! This one's a bit simpler. Just make fanart however you choose, pencils, watercolor, photoshop, illustrator, Microsoft paint, a .blend render, any way you want, digital or physical, then submit a picture to the discord server in Art-Submissions.

[h2]Art Competition Prizes[/h2]
[list]
[*] First Place will get a chance to design their own [b]Custom Skin[/b] that will be included in the next major update.
[*] Second and Third Place will get the entire register of [b]Space Skins[/b] as they release in the next update
[/list]



[h1]Space Skins[/h1]

We're sure you've been waiting to see these skins so frequently mentioned, so here's a sneak peak of a few [b]Space Skins[/b] in the bundle:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42657326/1490ffc825c9100607dc3a5031e17f585adc0675.png[/img]


[olist]
[*] American Astronaut - The first and easiest to obtain skin in the bundle, this is the one of the most commonly thought of astronaut helmets, as it is based on Niel Armstrong's helmet.
[*] Russian Cosmonaut - Tied in difficulty to obtain with the American Astronaut skin, the cosmonaut helmet is based on Alexei Leonov's suit, this space helmet has a fantastic green-brown base and silver visor is a remarkable skin. 
[*] Chinese Taikonaut - This golden colored helmet bearing the Chinese flag is not based on any particular Taikonaut but is a fantastic skin regardless, and will be slightly more difficult to obtain than the previously mentioned skins.
[*] Canadian Astronaut - This white helmet with a white base and fantastic blue stripe that bears the greatest flag flown in all the world (The 100% Canadian team at Bana Simulator is definitely not biased in saying this) is based on the suit worn by David Saint-Jacques, and will be just as difficult to obtain as the Taikonaut suit.
[*] {Redacted} - This {Redacted} will {Redacted} so that you can {Redacted}, and will be {Redacted} difficult to obtain.
[/olist]



[h1]Other Information[/h1]

We are accepting submissions for [b]both [/b] competitions at the time of this being written, and will stop accepting submissions along with the release of the [b]first major update[/b] in a few weeks. This update will be the first of a few steps we will be taking to get Bana Simulator's beta available to the general public.
I can't reveal too much about that update, but I will say there will be several more hours of [b]Story Content[/b] as well as a second full [b]Bossfight[/b], am I as excited as you?

We're so excited to see all the submissions for the [b]Bana Simulator Space Race Competition[/b]!


[i]The Bana Team reserves the right to modify or reject and custom weapons and skins designed by the competition winners.[/i]

notes.title: Hotfix 8296-A
notes.content:
Just a few bug fixes today, no new features!

[b]Balancing Changes[/b]

[list]
[*] Bana bow can now pierce no more than 5 targets
[*] Nerfed shadow skulls in endless mode
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed the "empty map bug"
[*] Player contact damage is no longer variable
[*] Fixed some lighting errors
[*] Fixed at least a dozen endless mode crashes
[/list]


We are so sorry to those of you who lost progress due to these crashes, some beta testers got exceptionally far into endless mode and lost their high score!

notes.title: First Minor Update
notes.content:
Hey there Banas!! Our closed Beta launch yesterday went very well, and our first beta reviews are fantastic! That being said, we have received quite a few bug reports, and a few of our major features weren't working! We managed to release not one, but two updates to fix these problems!! Here's some of the changes!


[b]Hotfix 8295-A[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed lounge not properly loading after a level. 
[*] Changed the 'shop' button to a 'skins' button
[*] Increased the range of electrob- super secret weapon!
[*] Enemies/potassium can no longer spawn near walls, traps, or the player.
[*] Removed the bullet ring from endless mode
[*] Added the quad-ray to endless mode
[*] Added a new level- the memory
[/list]

[b]MacOS Support[/b]

Although we thought we had this one from the start, some of our players pointed out that the game didn't open properly through MacOS. We have not only solved this problem, but improved this version of the game to be as responsive as it can be and have extra smooth gameplay.

[b]Hotfix 8295-B[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed 'Scrapper' achievement not loading properly in steam
[*] Added 'Bodey B.' to the credits
[*] Bana Bow no longer aims when the game is paused.
[*] Bana Bow will no longer consume potassium if a regular arrow has already been drawn back, instead it will be replaced by a charged arrow.
[*] Fixed a crash in level 5 where apple would say "SURPRI" and end the universe 
[*] Bana Bow will now do more damage the more you draw back
[*] Bana Bow will now launch arrows extra fast for easy aiming
[*] Bana Superbeam will now do double damage
[*] Supercharged Bana Arrows do triple damage
[*] Bana Ball Chargers now do more damage that Bana bullets
[*] The low health overlay is now togglable
[/list]

notes.title: A Very Special Event!!
notes.content:
Get ready for a super fun event on September 16th!  Join us on discord at [url=https://discord.gg/qUzBDU6zZP]our official Discord Server!![/url]

On the official Bana Simulator Discord server, join the developers for a first look at Bana Simulator, some gameplay, and maybe even the first trailer!! Despite all that, some of you don't even know what's in the story of Bana Simulator, so why don't we tell you a little bit!

[list]
[*] Explore the beaches, forests, and crags of Isla Bana, the first of many islands to come!
[*] Meet strange and wonderful friends that will help you, and make fun of you, on your journey!
[*] Collect weapons and upgrades to become the greatest Bana of them all!
[*] Unearth the ancient secrets of a seemingly normal island...
[*] And so much more!!
[/list]

Also at our event, a very special announcement, currently top secret, about Bana Simulator. As hyped as we are, we at the Bana Simulator team are going to keep this announcement a secret for now...

We hope to see you there!!
